Codename - Kids Next Door - Operation -.name: Codename: Kids Next Door - Operation: V.I.D.E.O.G.A.M.E.
Codename - Kids Next Door - Operation -.summary: Codename: Kids Next Door Operation: V.I.D.E.O.G.A.M.E. is a 2005 platformer video game based on the American animated television series Codename: Kids Next Door. It was released for the Nintendo GameCube, Xbox, and PlayStation 2 in North America, Europe, and Australia.

Mario Superstar Baseball.name: Mario Superstar Baseball
Mario Superstar Baseball.summary: The superstars of the Mushroom Kingdom have gathered on the diamond to power up America's game! Pick a captain, fill your team with your favorite characters from the Mario universe, then hit the field. Each captain has a special Star Skill for pitching and batting, so whether you're hurling fireballs as Mario or blasting curving banana-ball dingers as DK, you've never played ball like this!
